name: Lyxity
author: Infoforte

sections.description:
The new king of digital marketing is undeniably content, but not just any content. It must be “intelligent” content, and it must be managed with equal intelligence. This is precisely where Lyxity can save you hundreds of hours per month.

Lyxity is not simply another “dumb” content creation tool; it’s an intelligent platform that addresses the current and future demands of digital visibility head-on. In a digital world where the rules are constantly evolving, agencies and businesses need more than just tools; they need strategic partners. Lyxity is precisely that partner.

Unique Capabilities

  • Direct CMS Integration: Seamlessly operates within your website as a plugin, streamlining the entire content lifecycle from creation to publishing
  • Live Data Connection to Google Console: Pulls real-time insights directly from your website’s Google Console to inform content creation and updates
  • Instant Creation of Intelligent Content: Creates content that is inherently “intelligent” from inception, optimized for both AI and human readers
  • Intelligent Update of Legacy Content: Automatically reads, updates, enhances, and structures legacy content with factual and contextual improvements
  • Content Volume, Enhancement, and Structure: Adds content volume where needed, enhances existing narratives, and meticulously structures content for AI-driven search
  • Scalability for Agencies: Easily add and manage hundreds of client website domains with remarkable ease
  • Preview Changes: Review all AI-generated changes before applying them
  • Dashboard Analytics: Monitor content freshness and update history
  • Customizable Settings: Control how and when your content gets updated
  • Scheduled Updates: Set up automatic updates for stale content

Tangible Benefits

  • Increased Online Citations: Intelligent content naturally earns more citations across the digital landscape
  • Increased Online Impressions: Superior, AI-optimized content leads to higher visibility in search results and AI-generated summaries
  • Increased Online Digital Presence: Stronger, more pervasive digital presence positions your brand as a leader
  • Increased Effectiveness of Other Digital Marketing Strategies: Intelligent content amplifies every other marketing effort
  • Save Hundreds of Work Hours: Eliminate wasted time and money on ineffective manual content creation
  • Adapt to Algorithm Changes: Stay ahead of Google’s significant algorithm changes in 2024 and 2025
  • Optimize for AI Search: Prepare for the rise of AI in search (62% adoption, 2025 global AI Mode rollout)

External Services

This plugin connects to external API services to provide AI-powered content updating and rewriting functionality. These services are essential for the core functionality of the plugin.

Lyxity API Service

  • Service Purpose: The plugin connects to Lyxity’s API service to process your content using AI algorithms for updating and rewriting posts, generating summaries, checking for dead links, and providing dashboard analytics.
  • API Endpoint: https://lyxity.com/api/
  • Data Transmission: The following data is sent to the API:
    • Your API key for authentication
    • Page URL and content of posts being updated or rewritten
    • Site URL for dashboard analytics
    • Date ranges for analytics reporting
  • When Data is Sent: Data is transmitted when:
    • You preview content updates or enhancements
    • You apply content updates or enhancements to your posts
    • You access the dashboard analytics
  • Service Provider: This service is provided by Lyxity
    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/lyxity directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Lyxity > Settings to configure your API key and update preferences
  4. Start updating your content from the Lyxity main page
sections.faq:
My agency has invested heavily in traditional SEO. Is it truly useless now?

Traditional SEO, as many understood it, is not only largely ineffective but can actually be detrimental in the current landscape. Google’s algorithms, and especially its integrating AI, now prioritize deep context, genuine quality, user intent fulfillment, and structured data over superficial keyword matching or link quantity. Trying to force old methods will likely see your clients’ content overlooked or even penalized. It’s a complete shift in philosophy, not just a minor update.

How does Lyxity make content “intelligent”? What does that even mean?

Intelligent content, as Lyxity defines it, is content crafted to be easily understood and highly valued by both human readers and sophisticated AI systems. It goes far beyond simple keywords to consider an extensive array of factors: optimal content structure (headings, lists, schema markup), factual accuracy verified by live data, deep contextual relevance, the nuanced intent behind user search queries, and even subtle elements like title length, paragraph flow, and sentence complexity – all meticulously optimized for AI recognition and human engagement. It’s content that truly speaks to the algorithms while captivating the audience.

Can Lyxity really update all my clients’ old content automatically? That sounds like an impossible task.

Yes, this is one of Lyxity’s most powerful and unique capabilities, and it truly sets it apart. It autonomously reads existing legacy content on a website, identifies areas for improvement based on live Google Console data, and then updates it with factual and contextual information. It also enhances the overall quality, adds necessary volume, and structures it properly, transforming outdated or underperforming material into relevant, high-performing assets without the need for intensive manual effort. This process is critical because stale content can actively harm a site’s overall ranking.

We currently use a different AI writing tool for content generation. How is Lyxity different from those?

Many AI writing tools generate text, but Lyxity goes far beyond mere generation. It’s an intelligent content management ecosystem. While other tools might give you words, Lyxity connects directly to your client’s live Google Search Console data, allowing it to not only create new content but also factually and contextually update and enhance existing content based on real-time performance insights. It automates structuring and refining content specifically for the latest AI search demands and seamless integration with CMS platforms, which generic tools often miss entirely. Lyxity focuses on the entire lifecycle of content and its intelligent optimization for visibility and impact.

Is Lyxity difficult to integrate with existing client websites and their Content Management Systems?

Not at all. Lyxity is specifically engineered for ease of integration. It’s designed to connect seamlessly to client websites as a plugin-tool within their existing Content Management Systems. This ensures a smooth, non-disruptive, and rapid integration process, allowing agencies to deploy Lyxity’s power across their entire client portfolio with minimal technical overhead.

What kind of tangible time savings can an agency realistically expect to see by using Lyxity?

Based on direct experience, Lyxity consistently saves over 100 work hours per month. This drastic reduction in manual effort comes from automating tasks like content auditing, research for updates, content creation, optimization for AI, and direct publishing. This frees your team to focus on higher-value activities such as strategic planning, deepening client relationships, and developing truly innovative, bespoke campaigns, rather than the tedious and often unproductive manual work of content production and optimization that no longer yields results.

How does the AI know what to update?

Lyxity analyzes your content to identify outdated information, facts, statistics, and references. It then researches current information to provide accurate updates while connecting to your Google Search Console data for real-time insights.

Will the updates match my writing style?

Yes! The AI is designed to maintain your unique voice and writing style while updating the content.

Is there a limit to how many posts I can update?

The number of posts you can update depends on your subscription plan. Please visit Lyxity.com for plan details.

What’s the difference between “Update” and “Enhance”?

  • Update: Enhances your existing content by correcting outdated information and adding relevant details
  • Enhance: Completely enhances the content while maintaining the same topic and key points
